mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon tonight, and the ISS will be visible starting at 5:51 PM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and passing high in the sky toward the southeast near Festival Foods. Expect an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released candidate information packets for the 2027 spring election. All four Aldermanic districts are on the ballot, and interested candidates must submit their paperwork to the City Clerk by 5:00 PM on January 5, 2027.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or the 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 or live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly report, officers responded to a situation on November 9 where a driver was stopped on USH 18/151 for unsafe operation and subsequently arrested for a third-offence O W I.
Today's featured flavor is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by for a scoop before they close.
